title: Agents, tools and the MCP protocol

videos.script: An agent is a model in a loop with tools. The model decides. Your code acts. {{loop}} In this lesson you write that code. A host of sixty lines that asks the model, calls the tools it asks for, and sends the results back. {{host}} The tools come from an MCP server, a small program that offers them in a standard format, and you watch the protocol line by line. {{mcp}} Then the limits, because they all live in the host. A tool that refuses a path outside its folder. A refund that waits for a person to say yes. {{approval}} And two loops that would never end on their own. One asks for the same page twice. The other wanders for five steps until the host says stop. {{guards}} The model's decisions in this lesson were written by the course. The host, the server and every result are real.
